envelope.answer: behavioral change without a docs/ update — CLAUDE.md requires docs land in the same PR as the behavior change (The diff changes the default regex pattern for the `gh_pr_ticket` tool's pattern input parameter from `[A-Za-z]{2,6}[- ]?[0-9]+` to `\\b[A-Za-z]{2,6}[- ][0-9]+\\b`, making the separator between letters and digits mandatory instead of optional. This is a user-visible behavior change that affects how ticket IDs are extracted from PR metadata—it will now reject false matches like "arm64" or "utf8" that the old pattern would have matched. The accompanying documentation update in the comments and description fields confirms this is an intentional behavior change that users and plan authors would observe.)
